summary: Gives an overview of the Reliable Server Pooling (RSerPool) protocols and mechanisms. RSerPool offers application-independent services and protocols for building fault-tolerant and highly available client/server applications. It is informational and introduces the other documents in the suite.

eli5.summary: If one cashier is busy or gone, a good shop sends you to another. This explains a set of protocols that lets computers do the same, so a service keeps working when one machine fails.
